title: Newton's Laws of Motion
text: Isaac Newton's three laws of motion describe the relationship between a body and the forces acting on it. The first law (inertia) states an object remains at rest or in uniform motion unless acted on by an external force. The second law states force equals mass times acceleration (F=ma). The third law states that for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction. These laws form the foundation of classical mechanics and explain everyday phenomena from walking to rocket propulsion.
